title: Claude Code and Cowork can now use your computer
raw_excerpt: Claude Code and Claude Cowork can now open files, use browsers, and run dev tools on users' computers. The agent will prioritize connectors to supported services, but it can still execute tasks when connectors aren't available. It will ask for permission before taking action. Claude computer use is initially available to Claude Pro and Claude Max subscribers on macOS.
summary: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 现在可以直接使用用户的电脑，包括打开文件、使用浏览器和运行开发工具。该功能优先通过连接器访问受支持的服务，但也可在无连接器时直接执行任务，并在执行前请求权限。目前适用于 macOS 上的 Claude Pro 和 Claude Max 订阅用户。这标志着 AI 代理从对话式向自主操作电脑的重大跨越。

title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
raw_excerpt: A professor of physics supervised Claude through a real research calculation from start to finish without ever touching a file to see whether AI could do theoretical physics. This resulted in a technically rigorous, impactful, high-energy theoretical physics paper in two weeks instead of the usual year. While Claude was impressively capable, domain expertise was essential for evaluating its accuracy. AI is still not able to do end-to-end science, but the project proved that it can do frontier science with guidance.
summary: Anthropic 发布了一项实验成果：一位物理学教授全程指导 Claude 完成了一项真实的理论物理研究计算，最终在两周内产出了一篇高质量的高能理论物理论文，而通常需要一年。尽管 Claude 表现出色，但领域专业知识对于评估其准确性至关重要。该研究证明，AI 在人类指导下可以完成前沿科学工作，但尚不能独立进行端到端科学研究。

title: Claude Auto Mode
raw_excerpt: Anthropic released Auto Mode in research preview, enabling Claude to autonomously execute actions with built-in safeguards that filter risky behavior and prompt injection.
summary: Anthropic 发布了 Claude Auto Mode 研究预览版，使 Claude 能够自主执行操作，并内置了过滤风险行为和提示注入的安全机制。该模式进一步扩展了 Claude 的自主能力，让 AI 代理可以在更少人工干预下完成任务，同时保持安全性。

title: Goodbye to Sora
summary: OpenAI 宣布关闭其视频生成应用 Sora，距离其推出仅约 15 个月。Sora 曾因生成高质量视频而备受关注，但 OpenAI 正在削减成本并重新聚焦核心业务。迪士尼也因此退出了与 OpenAI 的合作。此举反映了 AI 视频生成领域商业化面临的挑战。

title: OpenAI raises additional money to bring record funding round to $120 billion, CFO tells Cramer
raw_excerpt: OpenAI has announced a new $10 billion commitment from a16z, DE Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG, and T Rowe Price. The fresh capital brings OpenAI's record fundraise to over $120 billion. OpenAI has moderated its spending plans and is now targeting approximately $600 billion in total compute spend through 2030. It is now taking steps to prioritize its most profitable initiatives ahead of an IPO.
summary: OpenAI 宣布获得来自 a16z、DE Shaw Ventures、MGX、TPG 和 T Rowe Price 的 100 亿美元新投资，使其本轮融资总额超过 1200 亿美元，创纪录。OpenAI 已放缓支出计划，目标到 2030 年总计算支出约 6000 亿美元，并优先推进最盈利的项目，为 IPO 做准备。

title: Show HN: Gemini can now natively embed video, so I built sub-second video search
raw_excerpt:
Gemini Embedding 2 can project raw video directly into a 768-dimensional vector space alongside text. No transcription, no frame captioning, no intermediate text. A query like "green car cutting me off" is directly comparable to a 30-second video clip at the vector level.

I used this to build a CLI that indexes hours of footage into ChromaDB, then searches it with natural language and auto-trims the matching clip. Demo video on the GitHub README. Indexing costs ~$2.50/hr of footage. Still-frame detection skips idle chunks, so security camera / sentry mode footage is much cheaper.
summary: 开发者利用 Gemini Embedding 2 的原生视频嵌入能力，构建了 sub-second 视频搜索工具 SentrySearch。该工具无需转录或帧字幕，直接将原始视频投影到 768 维向量空间，支持自然语言查询（如“绿色汽车别我”），索引成本约 2.5 美元/小时视频。展示了多模态嵌入在视频检索中的巨大潜力。

title: Trained on Tokens, Calibrated on Concepts: The Emergence of Semantic Calibration in LLMs
raw_excerpt: Semantic calibration appears to emerge as a byproduct of next-token prediction. Base models are remarkably well-calibrated when using a certain sampling-based notion of semantic calibration. They can meaningfully assess confidence in open-domain question-answering tasks despite not being explicitly trained to do so.
summary: 苹果机器学习研究团队发现，语义校准（semantic calibration）作为下一个词预测的副产品自然涌现。基础模型在开放域问答任务中，即使未经显式校准训练，也能通过基于采样的语义校准方法有意义地评估置信度。这一发现挑战了“校准需要专门训练”的传统认知。

title: Google's Extreme Vector Compression
raw_excerpt: TurboQuant is a quantization method that reduces vector memory overhead while preserving performance. This improves key-value cache efficiency and accelerates vector search.
summary: Google 发布 TurboQuant，一种极致的向量压缩量化方法，在保持性能的同时大幅减少向量内存开销。该方法可提升键值缓存效率和加速向量搜索，对于部署大规模 AI 模型具有重要实践意义。

title: Ray Data LLM enables 2x throughput over vLLM's synchronous LLM engine at production-scale
raw_excerpt: Many of the modern workloads that LLMs are increasingly utilized for prioritize throughput over per-request latency, which many LLM systems and deployments optimize for today. Ray Data LLM is a library built for large-scale batch inference for LLMs. It provides scalable execution, high throughput, and fault tolerance. It has a highly optimized architecture for running LLM batch inference. Users can achieve 2x throughput with Ray Data LLM over vLLM's synchronous LLM engine while benefiting from production-scale resiliency.
summary: Anyscale 推出 Ray Data LLM 库，专为大规模 LLM 批处理推理设计，相比 vLLM 的同步引擎实现 2 倍吞吐量，同时提供生产级容错能力。该库针对吞吐量优先于延迟的场景进行了高度优化，适合批量数据处理任务。

title: A New Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents (EVA)
summary: ServiceNow AI 在 Hugging Face 博客上发布了 EVA（Evaluating Voice Agents）框架，用于系统评估语音代理。该框架提供了标准化的评估方法，涵盖对话质量、任务完成度等多个维度，有助于推动语音 AI 代理的可靠性和实用性研究。
